definitions.name: def-e993blockproduct
definitions.canonical: Finite product of the explicitly truncated real polynomials. Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993blockmass
definitions.canonical: Real cast of choose(sum_i r_i,k). Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993blockcount
definitions.canonical: Actual cardinality of the fiber of S in block i. Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993subsetaverage
definitions.canonical: Sum of products f_i(K_i)/choose(r_i,K_i) over actual powersetCard k, divided by its actual cardinality. Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993blockexponent
definitions.canonical: Sum of guarded hypergeometric marginal weights times 2(f_i(t)-choose(r_i,t))/(f_i(t)+choose(r_i,t)). Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

definitions.name: def-e993exptaylor
definitions.canonical: Finite exponential Taylor sum from a=0 through d inclusive. Exact definition is in SOURCE/ENCODING-SPEC.lean.

hypotheses.canonical: For every i, 0<r_i; vacuous for empty I.
For every i and natural t<=r_i, real choose(r_i,t)<=f_i(t).
Natural k<=sum_i r_i. Natural d is arbitrary.

conclusion.canonical:
theorem e993_finite_block_coefficient_jensen
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : ι → ℕ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : ι → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i t, t ≤ r i → ((r i).choose t : ℝ) ≤ f i t)
    (k d : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ ∑ i, r i) :
    (e993BlockProduct r f).coeff k / e993BlockMass r k =
        e993SubsetAverage r f k ∧
    e993BlockMass r k * Real.exp (e993BlockExponent r f k) ≤
        (e993BlockProduct r f).coeff k ∧
    e993BlockMass r k * e993ExpTaylor d (e993BlockExponent r f k) ≤
        e993BlockMass r k * Real.exp (e993BlockExponent r f k)
